### Get the app

Two builds, either installs over the other, keeping your downloads and changes:

- `ClimbTheWorld-Release.apk`, the default build, with
  Google's [ARCore](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.google.ar.core) for a steadier
  A.R. view and placing nodes in A.R., on the phones that support it.
- `ClimbTheWorld-foss-Release.apk`, the same without ARCore, all free software.

Download the APK under **Assets** below and open it on the phone.
The [README](https://github.com/xyz-relativity/ClimbTheWorld-Android#install) has the details.

### Get updates automatically

Open the link of the build you want on the phone. It adds ClimbTheWorld
to [Obtainium](https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium)
or [ObtainX](https://github.com/bikram-agarwal/ObtainX), with its updates kept to that build:

- [ClimbTheWorld-foss-Release.obtainium](https://apps.obtainium.imranr.dev/redirect?r=obtainium://app/%7B%22id%22%3A%22com.climbtheworld.app%22%2C%22url%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fxyz-relativity%2FClimbTheWorld-Android%22%2C%22author%22%3A%22xyz-relativity%22%2C%22name%22%3A%22ClimbTheWorld%22%2C%22preferredApkIndex%22%3A0%2C%22additionalSettings%22%3A%22%7B%5C%22apkFilterRegEx%5C%22%3A%5C%22foss%5C%22%7D%22%7D)
- [ClimbTheWorld-Release.obtainium](https://apps.obtainium.imranr.dev/redirect?r=obtainium://app/%7B%22id%22%3A%22com.climbtheworld.app%22%2C%22url%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fxyz-relativity%2FClimbTheWorld-Android%22%2C%22author%22%3A%22xyz-relativity%22%2C%22name%22%3A%22ClimbTheWorld%22%2C%22preferredApkIndex%22%3A0%2C%22additionalSettings%22%3A%22%7B%5C%22apkFilterRegEx%5C%22%3A%5C%22ClimbTheWorld-Release%5C%22%7D%22%7D)
